description: Look a company up in GLEIF, the global Legal Entity Identifier register: LEI code, registered legal name, entity status, registration status, jurisdiction and address. The register's own name filter is a token search that returns thousands of unrelated rows, so matches are re-checked here and only an exact one — or one differing solely in legal form (Inc/Ltd/GmbH) — is reported as found; the rest come back as candidates.
